name: Pritilata Waddedar
contribution: Pritilata Waddedar participated in armed anti-colonial activism linked to the Chittagong revolutionary network and became a lasting symbol of women in militant resistance politics.
context: Chittagong and Bengal anti-colonial revolutionary politics in the early 1930s.
impact: Her death and memory became important in postcolonial narratives of sacrifice, gender, and anti-imperial struggle.
